serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Odaseva GovCloud is a SaaS data security platform empowering US government & government community organizations to better protect Salesforce application data. The Odaseva GovCloud platform scales to the largest & most complex Salesforce environments while providing a unified and strategic approach for Salesforce application data security. Odaseva GovCloud provides scalable backup and restore, multi-layer encryption, zero trust, data replication & archiving, sandbox seeding & ransomware mitigation.
